termsOfSale.title: Terms of Sale
termsOfSale.intro: These Terms of Sale govern your purchase of products from Nike, Inc. By placing an order, you agree to these terms.

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: By placing an order through our website, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Sale. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not place an order.

section2.title: 2. Pricing and Payment
section2.content: All prices are in US dollars and include applicable taxes. We reserve the right to change prices at any time. Payment must be made at the time of purchase.

section3.title: 3. Shipping and Delivery
section3.content: We ship to addresses within Venezuela. Delivery times vary based on location. We are not responsible for delays caused by the carrier.

section4.title: 4. Returns and Refunds
section4.content: We accept returns within 30 days of purchase. Items must be unworn and in original packaging. Refunds will be processed within 5-7 business days.

termsOfUse.title: Terms of Use
termsOfUse.intro: Welcome to Nike. These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of our website and services.

section1.title: 1. Use of Website
section1.content: You may use our website for lawful purposes only. You must not use the site in any way that may damage, disable, or impair the site.

section2.title: 2. User Accounts
section2.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

section3.title: 3. Intellectual Property
section3.content: All content on this website, including text, graphics, logos, and images, is owned by Nike, Inc. and protected by copyright laws.

section4.title: 4. Limitation of Liability
section4.content: Nike shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our website or products.

privacyPolicy.title: Nike Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At Nike, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, shipping address, and payment information when you place an order.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.content: We use your information to process orders, improve our services, communicate with you, and personalize your shopping experience.

section3.title: 3. Information Sharing
section3.content: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share information with service providers who help us operate our business.

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.content: We implement security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

section5.title: 5. Your Rights
section5.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. Contact us if you wish to exercise these rights.
